in_marathi.name: Ankurita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ankurita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ankurita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ankur' meaning 'seed'. This name is given to a girl symbolizing the beginning of a new life, growth, and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Ankurita is believed to bring blessings of fertility, prosperity, and success.
